segments.contextAfter: The request cannot be fulfilled because the requested resource, which is known to have previously existed, no longer exists. Usually this case results in a 404 status code, but when knowledge that a resource previously existed is important, the API returns a 410. This happens, for instance, if you request a user invitation after the user accepted the invitation.
